about: The overlap with c-unit-testing is deliberate and is the routing risk: both skills claim test work. The roadmap owns the incremental campaign towards a coverage target, c-unit-testing owns writing an individual test. A query about one must not pull in the other.

cases.query: improve unit test coverage for components/auto_off to 90%
cases.why: Names a component and a coverage target — the roadmap's core case, straight from its own usage examples.

cases.query: create a coverage roadmap for diagnostics.c
cases.why: Asks for the artefact by name.

cases.query: we need more tests for this module, coverage is around 40 percent
cases.why: Casual phrasing with no keyword from the description. The description claims to cover exactly this.

cases.query: resume test coverage improvement for communication_handler
cases.why: A resume. Added to the description on this branch, so it is worth measuring whether that worked.

cases.query: write a unit test for the function AutoOff_Init
cases.why: One function, one test, no campaign — c-unit-testing's case. Pulling in the roadmap here starts a multi-session process for a five-minute job.

cases.query: my gmock expectation fails with an unexpected call, what is wrong
cases.why: Debugging a single test. The roadmap has nothing to offer.
